experiment.topic: Statistical Validation of 30-Minute Opening Range Breakouts in BTC-USD, ETH-USD, and SOL-USD with 2%
experiment.hypothesis: A 30-minute opening range breakout with a 2% price threshold in BTC-USD, ETH-USD, or SOL-USD is statistically more likely to result in sustained price movement than random noise, given sufficient volume confirmation and prior regime stability.

test.note: No misleading proxy: hypothesis requires unavailable inputs or rule expression.

experiment.falsification_test: Over a 30-day period, if opening range breakouts in BTC-USD, ETH-USD, and SOL-USD with a 30-minute lookback and 2% price threshold fail to generate at least 10% positive returns on average, and no signal is confirmed by price action or volume confirmation, the hypothesis is falsified.
